subject: Re: APAC pilot - confirmation on non-training guarantee and retention/deletion process
messages:
From: Alicia Gomez <alicia@apacsystems.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: sec-ops@apacsystems.com
Date: 2028-10-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Clarification on training usage and retention for APAC pilot

Hi Jonas,

Thanks for the demo last week — APAC Systems is keen to move the pilot forward. Before we finalize the SOW we need explicit language and operational details on two items: 1) the statement in your docs that Redwood does not train models on customer data, and 2) retention & deletion timelines for logs, request payloads, and KV/prefix caches — especially for cross-border handling.

Could you confirm the exact guarantee you can put in contract language (we need something our legal & privacy teams can sign off on), and outline the deletion workflow (who executes deletion, retention windows, verification evidence). Also can you share SOC 2 evidence and any playbooks you use internally?

We'd like to avoid broad wording that could leave ambiguity around telemetry, aggregated signals, or optional programs. Please loop in legal/compliance if helpful.

Appreciate a short written response we can review ahead of a call.

Best,
Alicia
Product Security Manager
APAC Systems

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia@apacsystems.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-10-02T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Clarification on training usage and retention for APAC pilot

Hi Alicia — thanks for the clear list of asks. High level answers first, then a short operational summary below.

High level guarantee (contract-friendly):
- Redwood does not use customer content, request payloads, or customer-specific artifacts to train or update model weights for any hosted or dedicated customer account unless the customer explicitly opts into a named data-sharing program.

Nuances to be explicit about (to help your legal team):
- Telemetry and service metrics: we collect aggregated, non-identifying telemetry (error rates, system-level latencies) to operate and improve the service; these signals are not attached to customer content and are used in aggregate.
- Quality/benchmark programs: if a customer opts in we will seek explicit, documented consent; opt-in artifacts are treated as separate and covered by the opt-in agreement.

Operational retention summary (default hosted behavior):
- Request logs (routing/metadata): retained for 30 days by default for debugging/abuse detection; can be shortened per contract.
- Request payloads (full content payloads): not stored long-term for hosted accounts; ephemeral buffers are cleared within minutes. For auditing we retain a time-limited audit trace (hashes & minimal metadata) for up to 90 days unless an alternative is contracted.
- KV/prefix caches: per-call KV is ephemeral; persisted cache entries (when enabled for dedicated/private) are subject to customer's control in Private deployments or to dedicated-configured retention policies.

Deletion workflow (summary):
1) Customer requests deletion via support + contract addendum.
2) We schedule deletion job (target within 30 days for hosted defaults; faster timelines negotiable).
3) Deletion is performed at the storage layer and verified by checksum/manifest.
4) Proof of deletion is delivered as a verification report (manifest + timestamps) and retained in our compliance logs.

I've attached a short 'data-deletion-playbook' that describes the steps and artifacts we produce. I'm copying Laura from legal for precise contract language and SOC2 evidence. If you want a single-line clause for the SOW we can propose one post-legal review.

Next steps: Laura, can you confirm the legal-safe clause and whether we should route Alicia to a DocuSign addendum? Alicia — happy to review on a quick call this week.

Thanks,
Jonas
Sr. Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Alicia Gomez <alicia@apacsystems.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-10-03T13:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Clarification on training usage and retention for APAC pilot

Alicia / Jonas — quick legal/compliance note and proposed contract language.

Proposed clause (for SOW/addendum):
"Redwood Inference agrees that Customer Content will not be used to train, fine-tune, or otherwise update model weights or training corpora for Redwood-owned or Redwood-operated models, systems, or services, unless Customer provides separate, documented, and revocable consent to participate in a named data-sharing program. Aggregated operational telemetry that does not contain Customer Content may be used by Redwood for product and service improvement."

Retention specifics we recommend including in the addendum (defaults and negotiable terms):
- Debugging metadata and routing logs: retained 30 days (default).
- Audit traces (hashes, minimal metadata): retained 90 days for incident investigation and compliance.
- Customer-requested deletion: Redwood will execute deletion within thirty (30) calendar days of a verified deletion request for hosted accounts; for dedicated/private deployments, deletion timelines are subject to deployment arrangements and may be executed by the customer's infrastructure admin when deployed on-prem.

Evidence & attachments: attached a draft addendum and our SOC 2 summary. For APAC-specific residency we will document the physical region where data is stored for the pilot and can add contractual residency commitments for Dedicated or Private deployments.

Operational caveat (be explicit): this clause does not prevent customer-initiated opt-ins where a customer explicitly uploads data to a product feedback program or evaluation pipeline. Any such opt-in will be separate, documented, and revocable.

Marissa, can you attach the SOC2 runbook excerpt and confirm how quickly we can produce a deletion manifest for hosted customers?

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Gomez <alicia@apacsystems.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2028-10-04T15:43:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Clarification on training usage and retention for APAC pilot

Alicia — following up with the consolidated attachments and next steps.

Summary of commitments:
- "No-training" guarantee: Redwood will not use Customer Content to train or improve model weights absent explicit opt-in. See attached draft addendum for contract text.
- Retention defaults: routing/debug logs 30 days; audit traces 90 days; ephemeral request payloads cleared within minutes.
- Deletion: hosted deletion jobs executed within 30 days of verified request; verification manifest provided to customer.
- Residency: for the pilot we will store data in APAC region (Singapore) and will include residency language in the SOW for Dedicated/Private if required.

Attachments: SOC2-Summary.pdf; data-deletion-playbook.docx; no-training-addendum-draft.pdf

Proposed next steps:
1) Review the attached addendum and comment by EOD Friday so Laura can finalize legal language.
2) If acceptable, we'll route the addendum for signature via DocuSign (link below).
3) Schedule a 30-minute call to walk compliance/security through the deletion manifest and runbook.

DocuSign (proposed addendum): https://www.docusign.com/pack/addendum-ACCT-APAC-4321
HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/4321
Deletion playbook (drive): https://docs.google.com/document/d/1a2b3c-deletion-playbook

Look forward to locking this in — happy to jump on a call.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Sr. Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
